native_retrieval.snippet: # Associated Press. The **Associated Press** (**AP**) is an American not-for-profit news agency headquartered in New York City. Not to be confused with Australian Associated Press or Associated Press of Pakistan. Founded in 1846, it operates as a cooperative, unincorporated association, and produces news reports that are distributed to its members, major U.S. daily newspapers and radio and television broadcasters. As of 2025, the AP attracts more than 128 million monthly website visits, making it one of the top 10 news websites in the U.S. The Associated Press was formed in May 1846 by five daily newspapers in New York City to share the cost of transmitting news of the Mexican–American War. The venture was organized by Moses Yale Beach (1800–68), second publisher of *The Sun "The Sun (New York)")*, joined by the *New York Herald*, the *New York Courier and Enquirer*, *The Journal of Commerce*, and the *New York Evening Express*.
